title: Dynamics of planar integrable Kepler billiards with a focused hyperbolic branch
summary: We consider the integrable dynamics of a planar Kepler billiard in the plane bounded by a branch of a hyperbola focused at the Kepler center. As a sequel to our previous work \cite{JZ2}, we use the existence of the foci-caustic circle to identify an elliptic curve on which the dynamics is linearized and we analyze Cayley's condition on $n$-periodic orbits in this setting. By taking various limits also we discuss the dynamics of planar Kepler billiards with boundary being a focused parabolic arc, as well as a straight line.
